geometry.bodyPosture: selected seated Tripo cat, upright in a low hover

adaptations: actual optimized Tripo mesh with 48 interior fitted paw contact spheres
bounded continuous hover using beagle gain 25/damping 9/thrust cap g+12
virtual floating-paw contact frame and derivatives
measured seated hurt capsules and 0.58-unit body collision radius
beagle normal steering target 1.15 rad/s and finite feedback .70
reused: finite swing drive and reverse braking

limitations: Actual prepared Tripo mesh replaying an isolated current-game solver adapter, not actual game footage or a selectable character.
The seated body uses continuous bounded external hover lift; paw gravity is compensated. This is a new ordinary-hover proposal, distinct from the beagle timed F skill.
Paw spheres fit inside the actual mesh; small cosmetic surface gaps remain. Review before production integration and balance tuning.
No new cat ability or shared balance change.
